# Felipe Ortiz

> Felipe Ortiz. Cloud and Platform Engineer.

Hands-on with troubleshooting, infrastructure as code and multi-OS environments. Passionate about automation, continuous improvement and the people on the other end of the work.

  - [Graduate Program](https://fonixau.github.io/Portfolio/site/linfox/graduate/): Rotations from warehouse operations to data engineering and cloud (2022 to 2024) [Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Python, Terraform]
